title: Chapter 756 Surprised; Not Worthy!
content:
Chapter 756 Surprised; Not Worthy!

Chapter 756  Surprised; Not Worthy!

Great Era Dynasty.

A group of armored warriors patrolled the area in an orderly manner, looking extremely majestic.

Green Phoenix Hall.

A well-proportioned woman swayed her waist and slowly walked in.

The guards at the door knelt on one knee and said respectfully,"Greetings, Eldest Princess."

The palace maids inside also kowtowed and said,"Greetings, Eldest Princess."

The woman nodded at them and continued to move forward.

After a while, the Eldest Princess 'gaze fell on a thin woman.

She…It was Lin Chengzhen's beloved, Kexin.

The Eldest Princess sighed and called out,"Little sister…"

After Ke Xin heard the voice, his ears twitched slightly. His lifeless eyes had a hint of spirit as he said,"Big sister."

The Eldest Princess and Ke Xin were half-sisters.

However, their relationship was even better than having the same father and mother.

They had played games together since they were young and helped each other. They were best friends.

"Little sister, how did you become like this?""

She reached out and gently caressed Kexin's thin face, feeling extremely distressed.

"Kexin, can you tell me about him?"

He... Naturally, it was Lin Cheng Zhen.

Ke Xin seemed to recall the scene of Lin Chengzhen in her mind, and a sweet smile appeared on her face.

"He is very tall, very handsome, and a very interesting person…"

Ke Xin started talking about Lin Chengzhen's appearance, their encounter, and their daily lives.

The more she spoke, the wider the smile on her face became.

After that, Ke Xin could not help but dance.

The Eldest Princess saw all of this and said,"Little sister, it seems like you really like him."

"But can he really bring you happiness?"

"You have to know that this is a world where the strong are respected. Does he have the ability to protect you from being bullied?"

"I believe him," Ke Xin said seriously."

At this moment, a loud and clear voice suddenly sounded from outside.

"Keribo, come out!"

"Boom!"

This voice was like a thunderclap that resounded throughout the entire Great Era Dynasty.

Everyone's ears buzzed.

Keribo was the name of the Lord of the Great Dynasty.

Soon, roars could be heard from many places.

"How dare you!"

"Who dares to make a ruckus in my Great Era Dynasty?!"

"How dare you call my master by his name!"

....

The entire Great Era Dynasty became extremely noisy.

In many people's hearts, Keribo was not only the lord of the Great Dynasty, but also the heavens in their hearts!

"Whoosh!"

"Whoosh!"

Groups of people with powerful auras soared into the sky, wanting to find the person who was making a ruckus and kill him on the ground as punishment for his disrespect.

Among these people, there were star traveller level warriors who had just entered the void, star level warriors who could dominate a region in the star field, domain lord level warriors who enjoyed fame in the star field, universe level warriors who dominated the universe, and king level warriors who dominated the universe...

Their numbers were so great that the sky became dark.

"Get down!"

At this moment, another thunderous sound spread throughout the Great Era Universe.

"Hualala!"

In an instant, these experts fell to the ground like meteorites, creating holes in the ground and making it difficult for them to get up.

The might of one sentence was actually so tyrannical!

....

In the Great Era Palace.

Keribo was wearing a python robe, and his eyes were emitting a dim light as he looked at the sky.

There…Three people stood there.

They were Lin Fan, Lin Cheng Zhen, and Li Hao.

Keribo's expression was extremely solemn.

Clearly, he felt that Lin Fan wasn't someone to be trifled with.

After a long while, he said in a deep voice,"Gather the ten marshals, a hundred heavenly kings, and a million heavenly troops to follow me!""

"Yes, sir!" The soldiers in the distance said in unison.

....

In the void.

Lin Cheng Zhen and Li Hao knew that Lin Fan was very strong.

However, at this moment, they were still shocked.

After a few breaths of time, they arrived at the Great Era Dynasty.

What kind of speed was this?

It must be noted that even the fastest starship would take at least a year!

Also, what kind of power did Lin Fan use just now?

There were so many experts, and they all fell down with a roar?

"Whoosh!"

While Lin Cheng Zhen and Li Hao were in shock…

"Ang!"

A Golden Luck Dragon representing the Great Era Dynasty soared into the sky and instantly lit up the sky.

Then, countless armored warriors flew up and flew in his direction at high speed.

These armored warriors were at least at the planetary state.

Each of them had a tyrannical aura.

When these people stood together, they formed a military formation that was comparable to the might of heaven.

The terrifying aura was like a mountain that could topple and overturn the seas as it crushed towards Lin Fan, Lin Cheng Zhen, and Li Hao.

"Buzz!"

However, it was blocked by a transparent protective barrier on their surface and did not affect them at all.

The army that filled the sky stopped tens of kilometers away from Lin Fan, Lin Chengzhen, and Li Hao. They split up a path that was hundreds of meters wide in the middle.

"Ang!"

Ten huge golden dragons pulled a golden carriage out of the middle of the road and stopped steadily in front of the army.

The curtain of the carriage slowly opened, revealing Keribo, who was wearing a python robe.

"Who are you, Fellow Daoist?" he asked."

"You don't deserve to know my name."Lin Fan said calmly.

Lin Fan was returning the favor by saying that Lin Chengzhen wasn't worthy of marrying his daughter.

However, Lin Fan wasn't boasting.

That was because Lin Fan already knew about Keribo's cultivation base through the system.

He was only at Emperor level 6.

Under the observation of the Eye of Heaven, his entire body was densely packed with weaknesses.

Lin Fan could kill it with a single strike.

In this world, the strong were respected.

How could a weakling like Keribo know the name of an expert like Lin Fan?

Keribo's expression instantly turned ugly.

"Fellow Daoist, aren't you being too condescending?" he asked in a deep voice."

The generals behind him shouted loudly.

"Your Majesty, please allow me to capture this person!"

"Your Majesty, please allow me to capture this thief!"

"How dare you!"

....

Lin Fan dug his ears and said," It's too noisy."

"Kneel down!"

"Hualala!"

The million warriors who were originally valiant and spirited suddenly felt as if a mountain had appeared on their shoulders. Their legs instantly bent and they knelt in the void.

Only Keribo seemed to be relying on a special piece of equipment to support himself in the Void with great difficulty.

Sweat…It kept rolling off his forehead.

As soon as he said that, a million warriors knelt down!

It was simply terrifying!

This scene made Lin Chengzhen and Li Hao, who were standing behind him, gape again. They were completely stunned on the spot.
